scope: Derivation evidence for AppleCS35L19Amp transplant (se15.8.8 -> ipad6f 16.1)

analyzer_validation.method: CFG fixpoint this-tracking dataflow (regs+stack slots, lattice amp/vtab/other, interprocedural x0-x7 arg propagation), applied to se15 AppleCS42L71Audio vs reviewed se-cs42l71 profile (1091 fields)
analyzer_validation.best_config: vtable-entry x0=amp seeds + field loads propagate amp + call-arg propagation to fixpoint
analyzer_validation.disagreement_analysis: fp: mostly ldst/add rows on regs tagged amp via over-eager field-load propagation (member objects are not always EmbeddedAudio-family) plus a minority of genuine SevenUP-missed stores (e.g. str x31,[x19,#592] in 0xfffffff006c18860). fn: base regs tagged other whose amp provenance travels through non-modelled paths (globals, x1+ args, sub-objects, singleton reloads). For CS35L19 (single-class kext, nearly every function is a method) recall is materially better than the CS42L71 figure suggests.

slot_map.evidence: per-class vtable alignment (xnu-name anchors + unique normalized window signatures) on AppleEmbeddedAudio, AppleI2CMultipleAudio, AppleCSI2CMultipleAudio, AppleCSSPIAudio, AppleCSSPIv2Audio se15 vs ipad6f. Independently reproduces SevenUP slot() everywhere provable; additionally DISCOVERS that 15-slots 331/332 are not removed but moved to 16-slots 180/181 (window-sig identity, unique in each class), with one net new slot at 182.
slot_map.unproven: slots 328-330 map to 331-333 by position only (the functions are identical repeated stubs; any order among them is equivalent). slots 333-336 -> 334-337 same caveat.

class_chain: AppleCS35L19Amp(632,360 slots) -> AppleCSI2CMultipleAudio(472/480,359/360) -> AppleI2CMultipleAudio(472/480,358/359) -> AppleEmbeddedAudio(440/448,340/341) -> IOService
field_boundary: +8 shift applies at byte offset >= 408 (same as CS42L71; parent insertion point), confirmed: every analyzer-flagged field row has off>=408 and instance-size constant 632->640
bindings: 378 pointer slots resolved: 190 XNU symbols (byname), 172 EA functions (164 vtable-slot correspondence + 8 unique window sig), 5 via existing CS42L71 bindings, 5 via CS42L81 import-table/window/full-function matching, 4 same-bundle window/full-function matches, parent metaclass + parent vtable-header by assoc-block lookup. 1 literal 0xffffffff00000001 sentinel skipped.
